merges and the site rebuilds.

## Piece review follow-up

[PR #16](https://github.com/tungufoss/lowpoly-pdf-to-svg/pull/16), draft. Stage: fold
detection and hand corrections.

- A fold added in the piece review takes the mountain or valley style printed under it,
  read with the same dash classifier as traced folds. The hand pick only counts where no fold
  is printed. On 6 of the first 15 added folds the pick disagreed with the printed line.
- After hand edits, every piece is tidied: corners and fold ends within 0.8 mm become one
  point, a fold with another point on it is split there, and duplicate folds or folds along
  the cut are dropped.
- Brings in the full review of all 178 pieces: 46 folds added, 3 dropped, 19 corners moved.
- Clean number pairs go from 1462 to 1466 of 1575.

## 3D fold-up against the finished model

[PR #18](https://github.com/tungufoss/lowpoly-pdf-to-svg/pull/18), draft. Stage: 3D fold
check ([3D fold-up](fold3d.qmd)).

- `bowser.yaml` gets a `reference:` block with the finished model's size from its public
  Sketchfab metadata: 1238 triangles and 633 corners.
- `make -f fold3d.mk` writes `fold3d-baseline.csv`, comparing the folded trace with
  those counts. Corners stay doubled wherever a glue is missing or misread, so the corner
  difference measures how much matching is left.
- On the current trace: 1375 triangles (+137) and 862 corners (+229).
